title: Key with a zero-width space inside it
summary: U+200B inserted inside the key body.
rationale: Removing the one inserted code point gives the documented key; removing every invisible character is not assumed to preserve other values.

expectation.rationale: Project policy of this example: the inserted code point is not part of the secret; the bytes of the key, excluding it, are.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016). Synthetic; the policy stated here is an example, not a claim about any product.
